title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Maintenance release with no changes to extension behavior — corrects duplicate changelog entries and hardens the release pipeline for more reliable future publishes.

highlights.title: Duplicate Changelog Entries Fixed
highlights.description: Duplicate sections for v1.7.0, v1.0.0, and v0.7.6 have been removed, making the published changelog accurate and readable.

highlights.title: Safer Release Process
highlights.description: The release pipeline now performs a pre-flight tag check and applies changelog updates idempotently, reducing the risk of duplicate or malformed releases reaching users.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No changes to extension commands, settings, navigation, or any user-facing behavior since v1.10.0.
This release corrects the published changelog and improves release infrastructure only.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Removed duplicate changelog sections for v1.7.0, v1.0.0, and v0.7.6 that were incorrectly present in the published history.
Release script now validates that no matching tag already exists before proceeding, preventing accidental double-publishes.
